verdict.rationale: Orama documents an AnswerSession API for ChatGPT-like conversational answers with sources, built on vector/hybrid search and Secure Proxy to OpenAI, plus Orama Cloud's data-source/project model explicitly framed for RAG and retrieval, and a documented MCP server for AI interface integration. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of RAG output quality and no formal OpenAPI/answer-API reference spec (openapi probe 404s).
